notes.title: New update available!
notes.notes:
- Fixed an error that caused a black screen when entering some rooms.

- Increased the rewards when completing a search.

- Improved compatibility and performance.

notes.title: Big update available!
notes.notes:
- Secondary missions added. Talk to the villagers in order to discover them!

- New boss available! An amazing dragon is awaiting in the shadows of the castle.
 
- Russian language included

- Now, if you finish the single player mode, your money will be transferred to the multiplayer mode.

- Bug fixes and some improvements in the multiplayer mode. 

- Graphic FX and performance of the swords of ice and fire have been improved. 

- Tiny bugs in the scenario graphics has been fixed. 

- Some text typos corrected. 

- The fight system has been improved. 

- The AI of the enemies has been improved. 

- The interface has been improved.
 
- We've fixed some sound breaks. 
 
Changelog: http://steamcommunity.com/app/391600/discussions/0/152390648097147765/

notes.title: New update available
notes.notes:
Thanks everybody for buying King Lucas! 

We're receiving tons of feedback from you and we're working on it to make it even better. In next weeks we'll publish several updates to fix some bugs and add new features and content. The first of these updates has come, including:

- Possibility to respawn in multiplayer mode.

- Some fine tuning in the prices of items and weapons.

- Changes in the hardness and performance of some enemies to make them more challenging.

- Gamepad sensitivity adjusted to avoid deadzones.

- Small bugs fixed in single and multiplayer modes.

Changelog: http://steamcommunity.com/app/391600/discussions/0/152390648097147765/
